terms.s1Text: Welcome to ErrandOwl. ErrandOwl is owned and operated by TechyDez. By accessing and using ErrandOwl Pakistan ("the Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.
terms.s2Text: ErrandOwl is a marketplace platform that connects clients seeking services with independent taskers who provide those services. ErrandOwl does not directly employ taskers and is not responsible for the quality of work performed.
terms.s3Text: You must create an account to use certain features of the Platform. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities under your account.
terms.s4Text: Clients agree to pay the quoted price plus a 10% service fee. Payments are processed securely through Rapid Gateway. Taskers receive 85% of the task price, with the remaining 15% retained as a platform fee.
terms.s5Text: Clients may cancel bookings up to 2 hours before the scheduled time at no cost. Late cancellations may result in a fee of up to 25% of the booking value.
terms.s6Text: In case of disputes, both parties should first attempt to resolve the issue directly. If unresolved, ErrandOwl will mediate. Our Happiness Pledge ensures fair outcomes for all parties.
terms.s7Text: For questions about these terms, contact us at

privacy.s1Text: We collect information you provide directly to us, including your name, email address, phone number, location, and payment information. For taskers, we also collect CNIC details for verification purposes.
privacy.s2Text: We use your information to provide and improve our services, process payments, communicate with you, match you with taskers or clients, and ensure the safety and security of our platform.
privacy.s3Text: We share your information only as necessary to facilitate services (e.g., sharing your name and task details with your assigned tasker). We do not sell personal data to third parties.
privacy.s4Text: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information, including encryption in transit and at rest, secure authentication, and regular security audits.
privacy.s5Text: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You can update your profile information at any time or contact us to request data deletion.
privacy.s6Text: For privacy-related inquiries, contact our Data Protection Officer at

refund.s1Text: At ErrandOwl, your satisfaction is our priority. If you're not happy with a completed task, we'll work with you to make it right.
refund.s2Title: When You Can Request a Refund
refund.s2L1: Task was not completed as described
refund.s2L2: Tasker did not show up at the scheduled time
refund.s2L3: Quality of work was significantly below standard
refund.s3Text: Submit a refund request within 48 hours of task completion through your dashboard or by emailing support@errandowl.com.pk. We will review your case within 2 business days. Approved refunds for payments made via Rapid Gateway will be credited back to the original payment method within 5-10 business days.
refund.s4Text: Free cancellation up to 2 hours before the scheduled time. Late cancellations: up to 25% of booking value. No-shows by clients: full charge may apply.

About.title: About <h>ErrandOwl</h> Pakistan
About.subtitle: Connecting people with skilled taskers since 2024
About.missionText1: ErrandOwl was created with a simple idea: everyone deserves access to reliable, skilled help for life's everyday tasks. Whether it's assembling furniture, deep cleaning your home, or getting help with a move, we connect you with trusted, vetted taskers in your area across Pakistan.
About.missionText2: We believe in empowering both our customers and our taskers. For customers, we provide a seamless way to find and book help. For taskers, we provide a flexible platform to earn on their own schedule and build their reputation in the local community.
About.address: Office 402, 4th Floor, Arfa Software Technology Park, Ferozepur Road, Lahore, Pakistan
About.value_trust_desc: Every tasker is background-checked and CNIC-verified. Your safety is our top priority.
About.value_speed_desc: Same-day availability for most services in major Pakistani cities.
About.value_price_desc: Transparent pricing with no hidden fees. You agree on the price before booking.
About.value_community_desc: We're empowering local workers to build sustainable careers and serve their communities.

HowItWorks.title: How <h>ErrandOwl</h> Works
HowItWorks.subtitle: Your to-do list, done in three simple steps.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: Tell us what you need help with. Choose from a variety of services, pick a date and time, and give us a few details about the job.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: Browse through profiles of qualified, background-checked Taskers in your area. Compare their rates, reviews, and experience.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: Your Tasker arrives and gets the job done. Pay securely through the platform and leave a review when the task is complete.
HowItWorks.forTaskersSub: Earn money doing what you're good at
HowItWorks.tStep1Desc: Sign up, list your skills, set your hourly rate, and define your availability. Complete your background check to get verified.
HowItWorks.tStep2Desc: Browse available tasks that match your skills and location. Accept the ones that work for your schedule.
HowItWorks.tStep3Desc: Complete tasks to the highest standard. Great reviews lead to more bookings and higher earnings.
HowItWorks.tStep4Desc: Receive secure payments directly to your account. Keep 85% of every task — no hidden fees.

faqs.a1: Pricing varies by task and tasker. Each tasker sets their own hourly rate. You can compare rates before booking. A 10% service fee is added to cover platform costs and insurance.
faqs.a2: Yes! Every tasker goes through a comprehensive background check and CNIC verification before being approved to join the platform. Look for the verified badge on their profile.
faqs.a3: We have a Happiness Pledge. If you're not satisfied with the work, contact our support team and we'll work to make it right, including re-doing the task or providing a refund.
faqs.a4: All payments are processed securely through our platform via Rapid Gateway. We support JazzCash, EasyPaisa, and bank transfers. You're only charged when the task is completed.
faqs.a5: Absolutely! Click "Become a Tasker" to apply. You can set your own hours, rates, and choose which tasks to accept. It's free to join.
faqs.q6: What types of tasks can I book?
faqs.a6: Almost anything! From furniture assembly, cleaning, and moving to electrical work, painting, yard work, personal assistance, and more.

faqs.clientQ1: How do I book a task?
faqs.clientA1: Browse services or search for taskers, select one that fits your needs, fill in the details (date, time, location, description), and submit your booking request.
faqs.clientA2: Each tasker sets their own hourly rate. A 10% service fee is added to cover platform costs and insurance. You can compare rates before booking.
faqs.clientQ3: What if I am not satisfied?
faqs.clientA3: We have a Happiness Pledge. Contact our support team within 48 hours and we will work to make it right, including re-doing the task or providing a refund.
faqs.clientA4: Payments are processed securely via PayFast. We support JazzCash, EasyPaisa, and bank transfers. You are only charged when the task is completed.
faqs.clientA5: Yes, you can cancel a booking up to 2 hours before the scheduled time at no charge. Late cancellations may incur a small fee.
faqs.taskerQ1: How do I become a tasker?
faqs.taskerA1: Click 'Become a Tasker', create an account, complete the CNIC verification, and set up your profile with skills and rates.
faqs.taskerA2: You keep 85% of every task. Earnings depend on your hourly rate, number of tasks, and reviews. Top taskers earn Rs 50,000+ per month.
faqs.taskerA3: Payments are released within 24 hours of task completion and deposited to your registered account via Rapid Gateway.
faqs.taskerA4: Clients rate your work after completion. Higher ratings lead to more visibility and bookings.
faqs.accountQ1: How do I reset my password?
faqs.accountA1: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page. Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
faqs.accountA2: Yes. We use industry-standard encryption and follow best practices for data security. See our Privacy Policy for details.
faqs.accountQ3: How do I delete my account?
faqs.accountA3: Contact our support team at support@errandowl.com.pk and we will process your account deletion within 48 hours.
